'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine (2022–present)|Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[Poland]] announces that it will deliver four [[Mikoyan MiG-29|MiG-29]] [[fighter aircraft|fighter jet]]s to [[Ukraine]], becoming the first [[NATO]] member state to send warplanes to Ukraine. *[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Two militants including [[Islamic Jihad Movement in Palestine|Islamic Jihad]] and [[Hamas]] commanders and two civilians are killed and five others are injured during a raid by [[Israeli security forces]] in the [[Jenin refugee camp]], in the [[West Bank]]. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-734546 (''The Jerusalem Post'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/16/israeli-forces-kill-palestinians-in-latest-jenin-raid (Al Jazeera)] 
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Eight militants and two [[civilian]] children are killed during a [[military operation]] by the [[Pakistan Army]] in Zinghara, [[South Waziristan]]. [https://english.news.cn/20230316/dbe2ccc3a42143d387f7e7455deb455c/c.html (Xinhua)]
*[[Libyan Crisis (2011–present)|Libyan Crisis]]
**The [[Libyan National Army]] says that it has found about two and a half tonnes of [[uranium ore]] contained in ten drums,  near [[Chad–Libya border|the border]] with [[Chad]], that was reported missing by the [[International Atomic Energy Agency]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-64981875 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022–23 South-West Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Freddy]]
***The death toll from Cyclone Freddy increases to over 300, with most of the deaths occurring in [[Malawi]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/16/cyclone-freddy-toll-passes-300-as-mozambique-counts-bodies (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Two [[Edmonton Police Service|police officers]] are killed by a 16-year-old gunman while responding to a domestic dispute call at an apartment complex in [[Inglewood, Edmonton]], [[Canada]]. The perpetrator kills himself after seriously wounding his mother. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/edmonton/edmonton-police-devastated-by-shooting-deaths-of-2-officers-chief-says-1.6780632 (CBC News)]

*Over 220 [[Brazilian Army|Brazilian National Guardsmen]] are deployed to the northeastern [[Federative units of Brazil|states]] of [[Rio Grande do Norte]] and [[Paraíba]] after riots caused by imprisoned [[Crime in Brazil|gang members]] result in three deaths and class cancellations in both states. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-rioting-prison-gang-violence-d9ab671d2e9face86bd817599699c0b6 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 French pension reform strikes]]
**[[France|French]] President [[Emmanuel Macron]] invokes a [[Constitution of France|Constitutional amendment]] allowing him to circumvent the [[National Assembly (France)|National Assembly]] in order to pass a controversial reform bill raising the [[retirement age]] in the country from 62 to 64, without the bill going to a vote. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2023/03/16/world/france-pension-vote?smid=url-share (''The New York Times'')]
*The [[Parliament of Moldova|Moldovan parliament]] approves a law that formally declares [[Moldova|the country]]'s [[official language]] as [[Romanian language|Romanian]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/moldovan-parliament-approves-law-romanian-language-2023-03-16/ (Reuters)]

**The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] bans the use of [[China|Chinese]]-owned video-sharing app [[TikTok]] on all government devices, citing security concerns. [https://news.sky.com/story/uk-government-expected-to-ban-tiktok-from-work-phones-12835138 (Sky News)]
